output.headline: Nordic Capital brings a sponsor-leading record in the target's sub-sector, an open platform for an add-on, and capacity to pay near $200M.
output.differentiator: Among the financial sponsors on the list, it has the most deals in the target's own sub-sector (4) and in adjacent provider sub-sectors (18).

acquirer_overview.title: Provider specialist with a long, high-completion record
points: Financial sponsor with 24 deals from 2016 to 2024; 21 of 24 (88%) closed, and 9 since 2022. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent]
22 of 24 deals are control deals; Physician Groups is its largest sub-sector with 10 deals. [K:control_share, K:by_sub_sector]
Healthcare is one of four focus industries; Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion). [P:1, P:2]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Add-on to an open platform in the target's sub-sector
points: Its angles are an add-on to an open platform in the sub-sector, and provider specialist, with 4 deals in the target's own sub-sector. [A:angles, T:record]
Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and number of past deals are each a modest factor in its favour. [S:sector_rel, S:activity]
It sits second on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 4.8% across 107 buyers scored. [R:rank]

precedent_activity.title: Closed same-sub-sector buyouts, plus a 2024 Midwest recapitalization
points: Green Medical Center, 2022: $1,304M leveraged buyout at 15.0x; Harbor Medical Center, 2023: $991M buyout at 11.1x. Both closed. [D:MA-2022-0045, D:MA-2023-0466]
Principal Physician Group, 2024: $76M Midwest recapitalization at 15.9x, closed, in an adjacent provider sub-sector. [D:MA-2024-0431]
Harbor Health Network, 2024: $35M carve-out at 11.6x in the target's sub-sector; 8 of 24 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band. [D:MA-2024-0339, K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; Nordic's own multiples run lower
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x lower quartile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th. The 16.8% margin versus a 12.9% median supports the 75th. [V:comps]
Nordic's median paid is 12.5x, just under the 12.8x comparable median; its 2024 Midwest deal was struck at 15.9x. [V:comps, D:MA-2024-0431]
5.0x leverage, $128M equity cheque: 18.7% IRR at the ask against a 20% hurdle; maximum price $193M same exit, $216M at 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal is $77M, under half the $200M value.
risk_flags.mitigant: It closed buyouts of $991M and $1,304M, and Fund XI is about $11 billion.
risk_flags.reality: Biggest deal is $1,304M and 8 of 24 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band. [T:record, K:size_band, P:2]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask is 18.7%, short of the 20% hurdle.
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M.
risk_flags.reality: Same-exit maximum is $193M, below $200M, so the add-on route is needed to clear. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest footprint
risk_flags.concern: Geography is a signal against: 2 Midwest deals, while Welsh Carson and GTCR each have 6.
risk_flags.mitigant: Principal Physician Group, a Midwest deal, closed in 2024.
risk_flags.reality: Its top regions are Mountain West, Great Plains and West Coast. [S:geo_fit, T:record, D:MA-2024-0431]

conviction.rationale: High, based on 4 own-sub-sector and 18 adjacent-provider deals, an open platform for an add-on, and position 2 on the priority list; offset by a $77M median deal against $200M. [C:conviction, T:record, R:rank]
